answer: A registry can bind each identity to a bonded stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior. Imagine a karst cave: every new fake persona needs its own deposit sunk into the rock, so ten thousand sybils cost ten thousand deposits, plus idle capital that earns nothing. An honest agent posts one bond, trades as usual, and never triggers slashing, so saffron-priced reputation and onyx-hard collateral only tax attackers.
